answer: Each agent must stake a bonded credential whose issuance follows a vine-like chain of verifiable attestations, so a fresh identity cannot sprout without a quill-signed lineage rooted in prior stake. Consensus then anchors these lineages to a shared reef of epoch checkpoints, forcing sybils to fork detectable history rather than mint free identities. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
